reviews.text: I have used this cattery for at least 15 years and always know my cat is well cared for. She's now 19 years old. Excellent cat hotel.
Friendly owners and good facilities, reckon the cats are happy.

Nicest Cattery I have ever been to!! It has such lovely views for the cats and the pens are a great size. You can tell the owners really care about the cats too!  I would highly recommend it to anyone!
They are lovely people and our cat is always fine there, they take good care of the cats.
Fabulous cattery can very highly recommend
Very pleased . It was very clean and no mess any were. My 2 cats were look after we'll.. we are use them agin this year. As we use them last year. Thanks
Our kittens stayed for 7 days and were really well looked after! Will be using this service in the future for sure.

I collected my cat today after a weeks stay, she was happy and warm and well fed, her little room was clean and tidy. This is a great place and you can tell how much the staff love cats. Highly recommend 5 stars.
Excellent Facilities, helpful and friendly staff.
Our little one loved it there. The cats are well looked after, and the staff are great with the pets. Highly recommend.
